_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Performance Analysis Report
summary: Documents the methods, assumptions, and results for system level modeling and simulation performance analysis performed during design of equipment.
use_relationship:
Performance analysis report is the primary documentation for system level modeling and simulation analysis performed during design of equipment.  Within this document reside the methods, assumptions, and results for system level performance analysis.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work (SOW).

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81938.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: Title of CDRL and CDRL number
Table of Contents
children.content: The document shall contain a table of contents providing the number, title, and page number of each titled paragraph, figure, table, and appendix.

children.title: Scope
children.content: This section shall be divided into the following paragraphs:

children.title: Identification
children.content: This paragraph shall contain a full identification of the system and the components to which this document applies, including, as applicable, part numbers.

children.title: System overview
children.content: This paragraph shall briefly state the purpose of the system and the components to which this document applies.  It shall describe the general nature of the system and components of interest; summarize the history of system development, operation, and maintenance; identify the project sponsor, acquirer, user, developer, and support agencies; identify current and planned operating sites; and list other relevant documents.

children.title: Document overview
children.content: This paragraph shall summarize the purpose and contents of this document and shall describe any security or privacy considerations associated with its use.

children.title: Referenced documents
children.content: This section shall list the number, title, revision, and date of all documents referenced in this document.  This section shall also identify the source for all documents not available through normal Government stocking activities.

children.title: General approach
children.content: This section shall detail the general approach for assessing system capability with respect to governing performance requirements.  This section shall also include what software tools are used for which assessing which requirements.

children.title: Analytical Plan
children.content: This section shall detail the cases to be analyzed and justification for selection and or exclusion.  This section shall justify grouping of analysis for simplification if applicable.

children.title: Physics based methods
children.content: This section shall provide description and justification for all physics based calculations and processes used within the performance assessment.

children.title: Rule based methods
children.content: This section shall provide description and justification for all rule based calculations and processes used within the performance assessment.

children.title: Assumptions
children.content: This section shall list all relevant assumptions and provide justification.  As necessary sensitivities to demonstrate, significance of parameters shall be provided in this section.

children.title: Results
children.content: This section shall provide results of analysis.  This shall include relevant tables, figures, and conclusions.

children.title: Software artifacts
children.content: This section shall include all source code, macros, or other mechanisms required to conduct the performance assessment.

children.title: Notes
children.content: This section shall contain any general information that aids in understanding this document (e.g., background information, glossary, rationale).  This section shall include an alphabetical listing of all acronyms, abbreviations, and their meanings as used in this document and a list of any terms and definitions needed to understand this document.

children.title: Appendixes
children.content: Appendixes may be used to provide information published separately for convenience in document maintenance (e.g., charts, classified data).  As applicable, each appendix shall be referenced in the main body of the document where the data would normally have been provided.  Appendixes may be bound as separate documents for ease in handling.  Appendixes shall be lettered alphabetically (A, B, etc.).
